messages.subject: Error in order markers
parts:
Hello Professor Karl and rqtl users 

I am coming again with a new map. 
I was trying to find the order of the markers in two linkage groups and surprisingly I am receiving the following errors: 


data <- orderMarkers(data, chr=1, use.ripple=TRUE, error.prob=0.003, map.function=c("morgan"))
Error in cross$geno[[1]]$data[, orders[kk, ]] : subscript out of bounds

data <- orderMarkers(data, chr=2, use.ripple=TRUE, error.prob=0.003, map.function=c("kosambi"))
Error: cannot allocate vector of size 384.9 Mb

what you think about it

Best, 
Loukas

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Error in order markers
parts:
It's hard to tell without further information.

For the first error, could you send me the data privately, and I'll try to see what's going on?

For the second error, you're running out of memory; you either need a machine with more RAM, or try using a smaller number for the "window" argument. For example:

data <- orderMarkers(data, chr=2, use.ripple=TRUE, window=4, error.prob=0.003, map.function="kosambi")

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Re: Error in order markers
parts:
The first error is caused by you having multiple markers with the same name. Each marker name needs to be unique.

I fixed this by just omitting the second instance of each marker:

mn <- markernames(data, chr=1)
tab <- table(mn)
dup_names <- names(tab)[tab > 1]
col2drop <- NULL
for(i in dup_names)
col2drop <- c(col2drop, which(mn==i)[-1])
data$geno[[1]]$data <- data$geno[[1]]$data[,-col2drop]
data$geno[[1]]$map <- data$geno[[1]]$map[-col2drop]

karl
